30 Exploring Society: India and Beyond | Grade 7 Part 2 Framing the Neighbourhood When we think of a neighbour, we often imagine a country that shares a land boundary with us.
That is the traditional view of neighbourhood.
In that sense, Pakistan and Afghanistan in the northwest, China’s region of Tibet, Nepal, and Bhutan in the north, and Bangladesh and Myanmar in the east are indeed our neighbours.
